schema_json.description: Unified JSON Schema (draft-07) defining universal required fields (id, title, date, type, status), universal optional fields (team, tags, category, confidence, builds_on, description, cross_references, version), and per-subsystem extensions for KB, SCR, SOP, DATA, SRC, TEAM. Includes date_field_mapping and naming_conventions.

schema_validator.description: Validates entries against unified schema. Handles YAML frontmatter (KB, TEAM), JSON files (SRC, SOP), and index.json arrays (SCR, DATA). Reports missing required fields, type mismatches, legacy date warnings. Supports --json, --errors-only, --type filtering, recursive directory scan.

dedup_checker.description: Detects duplicates via title similarity (trigram Jaccard), content fingerprinting (5-word shingling), ID collision, and same-API-host detection for SRC entries. Outputs confidence scores and keep recommendations.

normalize_dates.description: Migrates 7 legacy date field variants (created, created_date, modified, generated, timestamp, added, last_updated, run_date) to canonical 'date' field. Supports --dry-run and --apply modes. Handles JSON and Markdown YAML frontmatter.

common_issues: Legacy date fields present instead of canonical 'date'
